papers.title: SpatialGuard: Harness-Guided Verifiable Spatial Reasoning for Text-to-Image Generation
papers.authors: Ziyun Qian, Zizhi Chen, Yizhou Liu, Mingyang Sun, Dingkang Yang, Lihua Zhang
papers.tags: image generation, 3D reconstruction, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: College of Intelligent Robotics and Advanced Manufacturing, Fudan University; Fysics Intelligence Technologies Co., Ltd. (Fysics AI)
papers.intro: SpatialGuard提出了一种基于布局引导的可验证空间推理框架，通过引入"布局约束带"（Layout Harness）机制，将复杂3D空间文本到图像生成从隐式提示跟随转变为可验证的规划-实现-验证-修复闭环过程。

papers.title: H3-World: Turning Language Understanding into World Control
papers.authors: Danze Chen, Zeqing Wang, Ziyue Lin, Xingyi Yang, Yeying Jin
papers.tags: video generation, diffusion model, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: Tencent, National University of Singapore, The Hong Kong Polytechnic University
papers.intro: H3-World提出了一种高效框架，通过将角色和相机动作表示为组合式文本指令，并引入时间注意力路由机制，仅用0.199%的可训练参数将33B参数的MiniMax-H3视频生成器转化为精确、时间可控的交互式世界模型。

papers.title: Revisiting Cross-View Completion: Self-Supervised Pre-Training via Reconstruction Error Comparison
papers.authors: Thibaut Loiseau, Guillaume Bourmaud, Vincent Lepetit
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, depth estimation, pose estimation
papers.affiliations: LIGM, Ecole Nationale des Ponts et Chaussées, IP Paris, Univ Gustave Eiffel, CNRS, France; Univ. Bordeaux, CNRS, Bordeaux INP, IMS, UMR 5218, France
papers.intro: 本文提出Gekko，一种通过预测跨视角补全误差与掩码自编码误差之间的相对改进量来提供全掩码区域双目训练信号的自监督预训练方法，在零样本对应估计、相对位姿估计和点图回归等任务上一致优于CroCo。

papers.title: DualDiff3D: Dual Structure-Appearance Diffusion Priors for Reliability-Enhanced 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Qian Wang, Yu Wang, Weiqi Li, Xinhua Cheng, Xiandong Meng, Ronggang Wang, Jian Zhang
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, diffusion model, image generation
papers.affiliations: School of Electronic and Computer Engineering, Peking University, Shenzhen, China; Pengcheng Laboratory, Shenzhen, China; Guangdong Provincial Key Laboratory of Ultra High Definition Immersive Media Technology, Shenzhen, China
papers.intro: 本文提出DualDiff3D，通过双分支扩散先验（结构分支与外观分支）配合结构-外观注意力（SAA）模块解耦处理结构和外观信息，并集成可靠性增强的渲染-精化-优化（RRO）循环，实现对稀疏视角下3DGS重建质量的显著提升。

papers.title: TempCloze: Can Video-LLMs Identify the Missing Middle?
papers.authors: Wenqi Pei, Henry Hengyuan Zhao, Yilai Liu, Jiahao Meng, Han Chen, Ziyu Wang, Hongyang Du
papers.tags: video segmentation, video generation, multimodal learning, video search
papers.affiliations: The University of Hong Kong, National University of Singapore, Peking University
papers.intro: TempCloze是一个视频完形填空基准，通过让模型从四个候选中识别给定开头和结尾之间的真实缺失中间段，从语义、对齐和进展三个维度评估Video-LLMs的视觉时间推理能力，并揭示了对齐（Alignment）是当前模型的主要瓶颈。

papers.title: CameraEditor: Camera-Controlled Image Editing via Video-Prior Sequential Modeling
papers.authors: Xin Shen, Chengyou Jia, Keshuo Xing, Zifeng Zhu, Changliang Xia, Bowen Ping, Zhuohang Dang, Hangwei Qian, Minnan Luo
papers.tags: image generation, video generation, diffusion model, 3D reconstruction
papers.affiliations: 西安交通大学（Xi'an Jiaotong University）、新加坡科技研究局（A*STAR）
papers.intro: CameraEditor提出了一种将相机控制图像编辑从空间问题重构为时间序列预测任务的框架，通过利用视频扩散模型的时间一致性、显式几何感知模块和动态参考路由机制，实现了精确的相机参数化编辑，并配套构建了训练数据集和评估基准CamEditor-Bench。

papers.title: Gaussian Core LoRA: Distribution-Aware Dynamic Adaptation for Broad Concept Erasure
papers.authors: Qinghui Gong, Xunlei Chen, Yu-Xuan Zhang, Hua Meng, Zhengchun Zhou
papers.tags: image generation, diffusion model, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: Southwest Jiaotong University（Qinghui Gong, Yu-Xuan Zhang, Hua Meng, Zhengchun Zhou）；University of Electronic Science and Technology of China（Xunlei Chen）
papers.intro: 本文提出Gaussian Core LoRA，一种分布感知的动态低秩适配框架，通过在高斯混合模型中建模目标概念的潜在语义原型，并根据输入提示的分布位置动态重构共享LoRA秩空间，实现对广泛概念的原型自适应擦除。

papers.title: Pix2Rep-v2: Data-Efficient Representation Learning for Dense Medical Imaging Applications
papers.authors: S. Sifaoui, E. Angelini, S. Toupin, T. Pezel, L. Le Folgoc
papers.tags: medical image, semantic segmentation, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: LTCI, Télécom Paris, Institut Polytechnique de Paris, Palaiseau, France; MIRACL.ai Laboratory, Hôpital Universitaire Lariboisière (AP-HP), Paris, France; Université Paris Cité, Inserm MASCOT, Paris, France
papers.intro: Pix2Rep-v2提出了一种基于冗余消除目标和等变性原则的密集自监督学习框架，通过高效的像素级表示学习和多尺度补丁采样策略，在少样本医学影像分割任务中显著超越全监督基线，并支持无需微调的原位上下文分割和视频传播。

papers.title: Semantic-Guided Multimodal Preprocessing for Vision Transformer-Based Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma Grading
papers.authors: Fatemeh Javadian, Zhu Chen, Zahra Aminparast, Johannes Stegmaier
papers.tags: medical image, image classification, vision transformer, semantic segmentation
papers.affiliations: RWTH Aachen University, Heinrich Heine University Düsseldorf, Kermanshah University
papers.intro: 本文提出一种语义引导的多模态预处理方法，通过将预训练细胞核分类模型的分类图与RGB组织病理图像融合，使Vision Transformer能够同时利用细粒度细胞核分级信息和粗粒度组织上下文进行CCRCC分级，在保持RGB纹理特征的同时显著提升分级性能。

papers.title: EdiTikZ: Scientific Figure Editing from Revision Trajectories
papers.authors: Christian Greisinger, Zhixue Zhao, Steffen Eger
papers.tags: multimodal learning, image generation, diffusion model
papers.affiliations: University of Technology Nuremberg（Christian Greisinger, Steffen Eger）；University of Sheffield（Zhixue Zhao）
papers.intro: 本文提出一种从自然发生的科学修订轨迹中挖掘大规模编辑监督数据的方法，构建了首个大规模科学图表编辑数据集DaEdiTikZ（391K编辑对），并训练了紧凑的EdiTikZ模型（4B和9B），在自动和人工评估中超越GPT-5.6-Sol并与Gemini-3.1-Pro持平。

papers.title: BRF-GS: Hyperspectral Bidirectional Reflectance Factor Modeling and Image Generation Based on 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Yiling Yao, Wenjuan Zhang, Bowen Wang, Bocheng Li, Wentao Song, Bing Zhang
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, image generation, diffusion model, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: Aerospace Information Research Institute, Chinese Academy of Sciences; International Research Center of Big Data for Sustainable Development Goals; University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
papers.intro: 本文提出BRF-GS，一种基于3D高斯泼溅的框架，通过引入混合BRDF驱动核表示、几何可靠波段选择和几何-光谱解耦的两阶段训练策略，实现遥感场景中高光谱双向反射因子建模和多角度反射率图像的高效生成。

papers.title: VeriCam: A Verification Baseline for the Classification of Unknown Data
papers.authors: Lucas Wojcik, Gabriel E. Lima, Sergio M. Silva, Eduil Nascimento, David Menotti
papers.tags: image classification, vision transformer, image retrieval, edge deployment
papers.affiliations: Federal University of Paraná（巴拉那联邦大学）；Paraná Military Police（巴拉那州军事警察）
papers.intro: VeriCam提出了一种基于验证网络（verification network）的零样本分类流水线，通过训练模型判别图像对是否属于同一类别来构建关系图，再利用图聚类算法实现对未知类别的动态识别，并在LPLCv2交通监控数据集上验证了其有效性。

papers.title: DreamX-Creator: Democratizing Native Audio-Video Generation at 2K Resolution
papers.authors: Jiashu Zhu, Yanhao Zheng, Ruitian Tian, Rujing Dang, Shen Zhang, Bingze Song, Jiachen Lei, Ruimin Lin, Jiahong Wu, Xiangxiang Chu
papers.tags: video generation, diffusion model, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: DreamX Team, Alibaba Group
papers.intro: DreamX-Creator 1.0 是一个以7B参数生成器为核心的紧凑型原生联合音视频生成系统，通过门控跨模态注意力、渐进式联合训练、音视频强化学习和自回归1步2K细化流水线，实现了与最先进开源系统竞争性能的原生同步音视频生成，并开源了模型权重。

papers.title: Real-Time Video Anomaly Detection Using YOLO Pose Estimation and CLIP-Based Semantic Scoring
papers.authors: Vanodhya G. Warnasooriya, Amir Hajian, Watchara Ruangsang, Supavadee Aramvith
papers.tags: pose estimation, CLIP, YOLO, video segmentation
papers.affiliations: Chulalongkorn University, King Mongkut's Univ. of Technology Thonburi
papers.intro: 本文提出一个轻量级两阶段视频异常检测框架，利用YOLO v11n-pose进行人员检测与姿态估计，再通过CLIP ViT-B/32对裁剪的人员区域进行文本-图像语义相似度评分，以直接余弦相似度替代多特征密度估计，在保持可比精度的同时实现3.36倍吞吐量提升（51.39 FPS）。

papers.title: Identity-Conditioned Latent Consistency Distillation for Face Synthesis
papers.authors: Tiago Kienen Chaves, Bernardo Biesseck, David Menotti
papers.tags: image generation, diffusion model
papers.affiliations: Federal University of Paraná（UFPR）；Bernardo Biesseck 同时隶属于 Federal Institute of Mato Grosso (IFMT)
papers.intro: 本文通过将Arc2Face扩散模型（教师）蒸馏为潜在一致性模型（学生），在保持图像质量的前提下，将身份条件化人脸生成的推理速度提升4.36倍，实现了大规模合成人脸数据集的高效生成。

papers.title: Segmentation of Bovid Dentition Under Imperfect Annotations: A Comparative Study of Convolutional and Attention Models
papers.authors: Keith G. Mills, Evan B. Sanders, Gregory J. Matthews, Juliet K. Brophy
papers.tags: semantic segmentation, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: LSU ATHENA Lab, Loyola Dept. Math & Stats, LSU Dept. Geography & Anthropology
papers.intro: 本文系统比较了从卷积神经网络到视觉Transformer的多种语义分割架构在标注不完美的B.O.V.I.D.牛科牙齿数据集上的表现，发现预处理技术对定量指标影响有限但对定性结果影响显著，且轻量级CNN编码器（如MobileNetV2）在性能上可与计算量数倍于其的SegFormer相媲美。

papers.title: DARP: A Calibrated Dual-Arm RGB-D-IR Dataset for Multi-View Robotic Perception
papers.authors: Manish Kansana, Mohammed Yusuf Mujawar, Sudip Mittal, Shahram Rahimi, Noorbakhsh Amiri Golilarz
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, pose estimation, depth estimation, point cloud, autonomous driving
papers.affiliations: Department of Computer Science, The University of Alabama, Tuscaloosa, AL, USA
papers.intro: 本文提出了DARP，一个由两台独立移动的眼在手机械臂采集的校准双RGB-D-IR数据集，通过保留传感器原始记录、机器人关节状态和校准信息，实现了共享度量坐标系下的多视角物体感知与确定性几何融合评估。

papers.title: Multi-View Reflective Surface Inspection via Semantic-Saliency Cross-Verification
papers.authors: Van-Giang Nguyen, Thanh-Tuan Tran, Xuan-Hieu Phan, Xiem HoangVan
papers.tags: object detection, image generation, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: University of Engineering and Technology, Vietnam National University, Hanoi 10000, Vietnam
papers.intro: 本文提出一种多视角反光表面检测框架，通过视觉语言模型产生的语义框与正常参考重建分支产生的显著性图进行空间交叉验证，在不修改语义坐标的前提下对检测结果进行重排序，并在产品层面无需跨视角配准地聚合多视角证据。

papers.title: Vision Models Predict Urban Scene Appraisal with Limited Neural Alignment
papers.authors: Kaizhen Tan, Yuantao Deng
papers.tags: scene understanding, image classification, CLIP
papers.affiliations: New York University
papers.intro: 该论文通过EEG数据系统评估了十七种视觉表征与人类城市场景神经几何的对应关系，发现当前视觉模型虽然能很好地预测人类评价（r=0.87），但与神经表征的对应度普遍较低（最高仅达噪声下限的29.6%），且预测能力与神经对齐度不相关。

papers.title: LOCI: A Locator-Critic with Refinement Loop
papers.authors: Walid Bousselham, Mathilde Caron, Arsha Nagrani, Cordelia Schmid
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual question answering, visual grounding
papers.affiliations: Google DeepMind
papers.intro: LOCI提出了一种无需训练的Locator-Critic多智能体框架，通过将视觉证据搜索与证据验证解耦，并利用迭代精化循环，显著提升了VLM在复杂视觉问答基准上的性能。
